base_hotspot_rules.smart_wallet: Use the configured Base Account and wallet_sendCalls/capability readback when available; one visible owner review per request; a receipt is not sufficient without finality and state-change evidence.
base_hotspot_rules.x402: Persist the HTTP 402 requirement, max payment, signed authorization, fulfillment and receipt separately; accept Base Mainnet/Base Sepolia only; payment does not prove invoice meaning.
base_hotspot_rules.b20: Begin on Base Vibenet and capture role, cap, pause, policy and permit semantics; do not market experimental evidence as production.
base_hotspot_rules.contract: Bind programmable settlement to the selected network, target contract and method semantics; require a successful final state-change receipt before ERP projection.
base_hotspot_rules.swap: Use Base Mainnet only; Base Docs states Base MCP swaps are not supported on testnets, so Base Sepolia is a rehearsal rejection rather than a swap route.
base_hotspot_rules.agentic: Use agentic workflow orchestration and Base/CDP tools only as product mechanisms; Agentic Wallet is not configured and cannot replace the Base Account.
base_hotspot_rules.test_iteration: Use Base Sepolia for ordinary integration rehearsal and Vibenet only for experimental chain features; revalidate before every promotion.

acceptance_requirements: Every case has one supported scenario/network pair and an explicit chainId.
A receipt must be successful, unique, final and prove a state-changing execution; pending, reverted, reorged or read-only evidence fails closed.
ERP readback must be authoritative, posted and bound to the same caseId and fingerprint; chain success alone never posts or closes ERP.
B20 evidence remains experimental on Base Vibenet; swap evidence is rejected on Base Sepolia; x402 evidence is limited to Base Mainnet/Base Sepolia.
Local tests and simulation remain L0/L1; no packet promotes to L2/L3 without the required external receipt and deterministic readback.

evidence_levels.L0: fixture or simulation; no external truth
evidence_levels.L2: unique successful testnet receipt plus deterministic product readback
evidence_levels.L3: unique Base Mainnet Smart Wallet receipt, authoritative ERP readback and complete publication evidence

counting_boundary.eligible: unique successful Base Mainnet state-change receipt from the configured Base Account / Smart Wallet
counting_boundary.publication_rule: Only complete all-required-platform bundles count under the existing 02_Build contract.

simulation_boundary.purpose: ERP mapping, reconciliation and failure-mode rehearsal only

external_action_policy: Only 02_Build may act after current-task live discovery, accepted typed handoff and the existing owner gates.
